Current Harvest Info
For any corn that is delivered and not contracted, we offer a short grace period for you to verify tickets/splits and get contracts written.
We are also offering a Price Later Contract with the following details:
Free through September 30, 2024
Pricing deadline = August 29, 2025
Service Fee = Prorated daily at $0.002 per bushel beginning October 1, 2024 (Approx. 6 cents per month)
Price Later bushels will be priced at the posted spot price and cannot be applied to forward contracts or sold for future delivery prices.
All bushels delivered in Aug/Sep that we have not received pricing instructions on will be applied to a Price Later Contract on October 1st.
